The rule the repository declares is: - Epic integration goes through a PR + CI gate: the orchestrator pushes the epic branch and opens a PR; the epic close-out may not complete until CI is green on that PR. No direct merges of epic branches to the default branch. **The merge itself is a person's**, and deliberately so: everything up to it — the waves, the per-tick gates, the final review, the close-out — is work a run can prove it did, while the merge is a judgement about whether to accept that work. A run's job is to hand a person a PR that is reviewed and CI-verified, so the judgement is quick; it is not to make it.
